en: The postcard features a black and white panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a hilly landscape. Central in the image is a prominent church with a tall spire, surrounded by quaint traditional houses. On a hill in the background, a large building resembling a castle or manor stands out, possibly indicating a historical landmark. The upper right contains red text reading 'Neuhausen i. Sa.', likely the name of the town.
